book.name: 2 TIMOTI
book.title: Timotida luhuwa naba 2 Polokaho je miye

content: Nemoya Omaimidana omudalalo ito Jisesi Kalaestikaho minoko lomudaki wewena ito helebo wewenaki ona mololetakolo noibo wemidana omudalaloya Jisesiya elewoleyalaki soto pekoko ujapa oletatibomuye loko lo hukoko lo imituyo, elo.

Emoya monoka lo soto moloko lo bitadawomuya wewenasi delatihe, ito delametihe, yatoka aha nesa neyo, opaya lo bo. Sa-oneyo, data leko dilipe elewole oko dilipe wehe loko osele elamideko api-napi obeto.

Sakiya mini-liki yowiki onawa mako alili okadeko, monoka watiyamuya auha likiki hulakilae. Sa-ikiki monokaya datadunu lahelepa onedekogo eletune likiki monoka api-napi itabo wewenasida dilipi napa ikiki dumu helitibomu opa ga li bikadeko,
monoka wehe lokomidana maya demesa mikiki hiyega gau maya wiki kolakilae.

Sa-itabo neyo, emoya muki yupeka ataka ele wehe lokogo mino. Asowalaki nesa makolimo upakalo tewa noideko maya elewole o. Omaimidana ga lalowa lo soto molokaka yowanu noleko le owo jitane. Omaimidana yowanula maya muki le oheko lo.
Nemodaya kohane-liki uda jitibo nupalotiya miyuhawa liki nakilae. Sa-ikilanako, nemoya alo hulolibetatubo onawa alili okaiye.

Nemoya yowanu lalo le-loko wobo maya alo leko suwo-minoe. Onouya emo asiyoko emo asiyoko ikaka niabomidana yowanu le-loko woko makilo maya alo hetokoe. Ga watiyamidana ujapa obo nesa maya wina amibo ne.

Ito okulumauti onowelaki adakoli lalo wewesiki miniki liki niabo wewenasida nesanipolimo newa noiye. Minoko onawa napaloya We napa le wehe loko ona molokaka wemamo nemoki muki wewenaki emo hetatibo onawamu ewa oko ubolo o-minokaka noudawo wewenaya aya adakoli maya leko niseko olo jeletakolaiye.
Maloka wewenasida ganipo.
Emoya nemotoka nisituwe loko maya abuha moloko enemane oko nisitadawomuya noloe.

Temasikahoya maya mikauka nesamu eliyoko dowa lokaiyoko, hulonetokadanaki Tesolonika numutoka wokaiye. Sa-okaiyoko, Kelesese maya Galaisiya numutokaya wiye. Ito Taetasi maya Dalamatiya ebakukaya wiye.
Sa-ikayoko, nemoya makoko Lukakiya minoiye. Sa-iminayo, Makida maya ilime-loko nisitane. Makimamo yowanuguya nilime wati etiye loko noloyo, ilime-loko nisitane.
Ito Tikikasida maya oli hoyoko, Epesisi numutokaya nowiye.

Sa-oneyo, maloka nisekolo noko maya lasigu olo jekaka lawo-lawo maya Tilowasi numutoka Kapasida numudalalo ololoha oko molonebo maya lenetokokiya niso. Ito monoka pepane ito pepa ailawa mako molo-minobomakiya leko niso.
Kapadunu saina-maina lolo okaka we Alesadeya lahelamibo nesa oha lenetokaiyoko, yamuya minoko alikaya We napalimo lihimalaya saina lolo ibomidana makoko aweyaha oko mekolaiye.
Sa-oneyo, emodaya ilime opa-napa okatiyo, ujapa etoha oko mino. Sa-noko aya welimoya abuha moloko monoka gatemuya mesaha jiye.

Obi noyoko adaya api oko nemo monawanemu lo soto obotoya wewena makolimo niseko nilimeko gaya lamiye. Edimo muki wewenasiya nemoda hulinitiminabo maya ne. Sa-iminabo maya neyo, yamidana lihimaya Omailimo le hulobetadeyo.

We napalimo nasahili onetoko nilime elewole idanaki gala lalowa maya lo soto molo-loko nowoko suwetane loko, ito hetoka wewenasi eli suwitae loko, luhawane maya le ilitonetaiye. Sakokoya We napalimo asowalaki nesamidana epalauti nilimidanaki wina onetokaiye.

Ito We napalimoya lahelamibo nesa yamuhe mamuhe nilime wati oko olisauti nilimeko okuluma ebalau mukito nilime molakolaiye. Sakoko emo lamedala maya mino-loko woko minakolaiye. Watiyae. 10 Kol 4:14; Pai 24; 2 Kol 8:23; Gal 2:3 11 Apo 12:12; Apo 13:13; Apo 15:37-39 12 Ipi 6:21-22 13 Apo 20:6 14 1 Tim 1:20; Sam 62:12; Lom 2:6
Dupamu elaiyoko lo biye.
Ito maya Piliskaki mena wauna Akuilakiyo ito Onesipoloda wewenala yuhaki dupamu nelokaiyoko noloyo, sa-loko lo bo.
Elasito maya Kolinti numutokaya ne, ito Tolopimasidamu elokaiyoko Mileto numutokaya huloeto-minoe.
Sa-ominoyo, emoya nisituwe loko maya go onawa maya owaha amideko, abuha moloko niso. Eupuloya upakamu elokaiyo, ito Putenete ito Lino ito Kalautiyateya edimoki maloka wewenatelekiya upamu delokaiye.
We napatelimoya weuka oluholoka minadeyo. Sa-oneyo, Omailokatiya nasahili maya edimotoka mino moloko minadeyo. 19 Apo 18:2; 2 Tim 1:16-17 20 Apo 19:22; Apo 20:4
